name: Kneser Graph Intersection Disguise
description: Replaces the algebraic characteristic equation condition with an equivalent set-intersection condition based on the Kneser graph $KG_{3,2}$. By mapping the 3 colors to the 3 distinct 2-element subsets of a 3-element set, the inequality constraint $h_u \neq h_v$ is perfectly encoded as the requirement that the sets share exactly one element. This defeats pattern-matching to 3-coloring while remaining mathematically rigorous and simple to state.
